limitations.text: Single seed; the E9 control is pending.

Every training-time `val_loss` / `val_bits_per_char` so far (E0, E1, E2, E3, E9, E10, K7) is measured on a val that is ~42% near-memorisable. **Absolute numbers are inflated.** Comparisons may be confounded if architectures memorise repeats differently (attention vs GDN recall).

Everything produced before Phase 2b on LM training is single-seed (E0-E3, E9; K7 sweep; K4 has 2 seeds). Treated as **exploratory** until replicated under section 2; Phase 2b (E10, E1, E11 at n = 3) is the first confirmatory comparison. The retro-audit is in `experiments/stats/proposed-claims.md`.
